picks.editorial_note: The University of Washington is leading or supporting four DOE Genesis Mission awards, part of a national AI-for-science initiative spanning 300+ institutions — a signal of how deeply the federal government is now betting on AI to accelerate basic research.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: Brookhaven National Laboratory and Stony Brook University will build a $14.2M AI foundation model for the U.S. electric grid, a concrete example of AI infrastructure being applied to critical national infrastructure under the Genesis Mission.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $10M OpenAI Foundation grant to Notre Dame's AIM for Scale initiative will bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers, a rare example of frontier AI funding translating directly into real-world humanitarian impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's rollout of ChatGPT Edu to over 80,000 students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, illustrating how quickly major AI vendors are embedding themselves in higher education at scale.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million gift establishing a dedicated College of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics at the University of North Texas reflects the growing trend of philanthropic capital reshaping university AI infrastructure and talent pipelines.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: The University of Kentucky's selection for the DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative shows AI's expansion into industrial and resource-extraction sectors well beyond traditional academic research.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot with CSIRO, the University of Queensland, and ResetData to make data centre GPU workloads dynamically shiftable tackles one of AI's most pressing infrastructure bottlenecks: grid strain from AI compute demand.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim to have solved a Millennium Prize math problem — met with public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao — is a high-stakes test case for how AI breakthrough claims get vetted by the scientific community.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory technology achieves 100x higher storage density using tantalum and vanadium oxide, a genuine materials-science advance that could reshape the hardware underpinning future AI devices.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: USF's unveiling of its new Bellini College of Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity and Computing building, backed by a $40 million gift, marks another major university investment in dedicated AI-focused facilities and degree programs.
picks.title: USF President Limayem announces location, unveils plans for new Bellini College building
